chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī
Whoever acknowledges a child and then denies him shall be flogged with the legal punishment and made responsible for the child.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator to whom this report is attributed
key_terms.الْوَلَدَ: the child whose attribution is legally maintained
key_terms.بِوَلَدٍ: with respect to a child, meaning attribution of parentage
key_terms.نَفَاهُ: denied him or repudiated his lineage

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on someone who acknowledges a child and then later denies the child's lineage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who affirms a child's lineage and then later denies it. It states that such a person is subject to the hadd punishment and remains legally bound to the child, underscoring the seriousness of lineage and the rights attached to it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5074 - In the narration of Al-Sakuni,
Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Whoever acknowledges a child and then denies him is to be given the legal punishment and held responsible for the child."
